content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Online travel marketplace for short-term stays and experiences; no lease-to-own payment business like the target."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Online marketplace matching homeowners with service pros, earning memberships and lead fees; not consumer lease financing."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Buys and collects charged-off consumer debt; it does not lease merchandise or fund merchant purchases."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Franchisor of blue-collar staffing offices earning royalties; no consumer leasing or merchant financing."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Freight transportation and logistics for shippers; unrelated to consumer lease-to-own payment plans."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate tenants; no consumer goods leasing or payment plans."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Purchases and collects charged-off consumer debt; does not lease goods or fund consumer merchandise purchases."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Vehicle transportation and logistics for automakers and dealers; unrelated to consumer lease-to-own financing."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases suburban shopping centers to retailers; it is real estate, not consumer lease financing."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage and program administration earning commissions; no lease-to-own or consumer merchandise business."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Lease-to-own access to furniture, electronics and appliances for limited-credit consumers, with partner merchant checkout, matching the target."}]}
